summary: A targeted weapon within 20' cannot be wielded for 30 seconds, except by players Immune to Flame.

effects.subject: target-equipment
effects.note: Players who are Immune to Flame may continue to wield the weapon (E2).

properties.note: Only the weapon needs to be within range and visible.

references.name: Immune to Flame
references.note: Players Immune to Flame may still wield the heated weapon.

clarifications.text: Players who are Immune to Flame may keep wielding the weapon.
The weapon, not its wielder, is the target; only the weapon needs to be in range and visible.

open_questions: E2 names players Immune to Flame; unclear whether other Flame protections (e.g. Resistance to Flame) also let the weapon be wielded.
